from common import *
import numpy as np,pandas as pd
from backtest.scripts.evaluate import eval_ic_multi_pool as ev
from backtest.scripts.maintenance import experiment_harness as native
def main():
    save_source(__file__)
    c=read(BASE/'metrics/comparison.json')
    saved=pd.read_pickle(TMP/'official-evaluation-inputs.pkl')
    vals=pd.read_pickle(BUNDLE/'P-ensemble.pkl').iloc[:,0];y=saved['labels'][5];trad=saved['tradable'];labs=day_labels()
    fwd=ev.daily_head_panel(vals,y,[3],tradable=trad)[3]
    rev=ev.daily_head_panel(vals.iloc[::-1],y,[3],tradable=trad)[3]
    days=fwd['port'].index;assert days.equals(rev['port'].index) and len(days)==1448
    pdates=set(days[labs.reindex(days).eq('P')])
    def evaluate(panel,subset):
        t=sorted(subset)
        return ev.summarize_head_series(panel['excess'].loc[t],5,sets=panel['sets'],k=3,turnover_days=subset,port=panel['port'].loc[t],bench=panel['bench'].loc[t])
    reference=c['by_style']['P']['v5']
    dates=[d for d in days if fwd['sets'][d]!=rev['sets'][d]]
    out={'reversed_top3_date_changes':[str(d.date()) for d in dates],'changed_source_or_t_minus_5_on_panic_dates':[str(d.date()) for i,d in enumerate(days) if d in pdates and (d in dates or (i>=5 and days[i-5] in dates))],'candidates':{}}
    for mode,panel in [('forward',fwd),('reverse',rev)]:
        score=evaluate(panel,pdates)
        out['candidates'][mode]={k:score[k] for k in ['n_days','net_ann','net_sharpe','turnover']}
    assert abs(out['candidates']['forward']['net_ann']-c['by_style']['P']['candidate']['net_ann'])<1e-12
    assert len(dates)==c['by_style']['P']['all_top3_ties']
    out['both_metrics_beat_v5_both_orders']=all(z['net_ann']>reference['net_ann'] and z['net_sharpe']>reference['net_sharpe'] for z in out['candidates'].values())
    write(BASE/'docs/panic-reverse-portfolio.json',out)
    print(json.dumps(out),flush=True)
if __name__=='__main__':main()
